name: Support and refund agent
author: ThreatVeil
summary: A support agent that can refund money and message customers: the refund limit, approval and external-message claims, and the ledger observer that must witness a committed refund.

compatibility.note: Assumes refunds are recorded in a billing ledger you can read independently of the agent.

dependency_proposals.evidence: The refund tool's declared approval condition controls the approval the refund claims depend on.
The declared maximum amount on the refund tool is the limit this claim depends on.
The messaging tool's declared approval condition controls external message approval.

observer_requirements.system_of_record: The billing ledger that records committed refunds
observer_requirements.note: A refund that was issued and then reversed is still a refund that committed.
Delivery is the committed effect; a queued message is not yet delivered.

limitations: This is ThreatVeil's leading hypothesis for a first archetype, not a validated pack.
Refund partials, currency conversion and chargebacks are out of scope.
Claims are declared until an approved executable check with a qualified observer is bound to them.
